'''''Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil''''' is a novel from the point of view of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], surrounding the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
